```python
def solve(case):
    segments = case["segments"]
    budget = case["budget"]
    
    n = len(segments)
    minimums = [s["minimum"] for s in segments]
    capacities = [s["capacity"] for s in segments]
    importances = [s["importance"] for s in segments]
    names = [s["name"] for s in segments]
    
    sum_min = sum(minimums)
    sum_cap = sum(capacities)
    
    if budget < sum_min or budget > sum_cap:
        raise ValueError("Budget out of valid range")
    
    allocs = list(minimums)
    remaining = budget - sum_min
    
    while remaining > 0:
        best_idx = -1
        best_priority = -1
        for i in range(n):
            if allocs[i] >= capacities[i]:
                continue
            priority = importances[i] / (allocs[i] + 1)
            if best_idx == -1 or priority > best_priority:
                best_priority = priority
                best_idx = i
        
        if best_idx == -1:
            break  # shouldn't happen if budget <= sum_cap
        
        allocs[best_idx] += 1
        remaining -= 1
    
    by_name = {names[i]: allocs[i] for i in range(n)}
    total = sum(allocs)
    
    return {
        "allocations": allocs,
        "by_name": by_name,
        "total": total
    }
```
